question: ¿Cuántos proveedores distintos (por UEI) se llaman igual que una empresa u organización de la Lista Consolidada de Control, por su nombre o por un alias, si se ignoran mayúsculas, puntuación y formas societarias como Inc., LLC o Corp.?

attempts.query:
WITH lista AS (
  SELECT e.name AS n FROM csl.entry e WHERE COALESCE(e.type, '') IN ('Entity', '')
  UNION
  SELECT a FROM csl.entry e, unnest(e.alt_names) a WHERE COALESCE(e.type, '') IN ('Entity', '')
),
lista_norm AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(lower(n), '[.,'']', '', 'g'), '[^a-z0-9]+', ' ', 'g'), '\m(inc|incorporated|llc|corp|corporation|co|company|ltd|limited|plc|lp|llp|pllc)\M', ' ', 'g'), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) AS k
  FROM lista WHERE n IS NOT NULL
),
prov AS (
  SELECT r.uei, trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(lower(r.name), '[.,'']', '', 'g'), '[^a-z0-9]+', ' ', 'g'), '\m(inc|incorporated|llc|corp|corporation|co|company|ltd|limited|plc|lp|llp|pllc)\M', ' ', 'g'), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) AS k
  FROM usaspending.recipient r WHERE r.uei IS NOT NULL AND r.name IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT count(DISTINCT p.uei)
FROM prov p JOIN lista_norm l ON l.k = p.k
WHERE p.k <> ''
